## [3.2.0](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0) (2026-09-25)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Facebook: open profiles and settings on re-signed Facebook builds ([69a2f20](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/69a2f20cbea21ffe49b3421c3ab56b0ec62cdf57))
* Facebook: block the ads and the sponsored product banner inside a reel ([23334d1](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/23334d14ec7462ac696dbf5b624475f6887409e2), [0d930d1](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/0d930d1e348912d172eeab04de8881d77b62af11))
* Facebook: stop the Reels ad-break lookup instead of retrying it ([eaca2ee](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/eaca2ee9fcd2b427bb561ae53ee3fba775092c8b))
* Facebook: save a photo story as a picture, and save stories with our own downloader ([56d7957](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/56d7957ce7933c153301dbf6c4b77afa75b7315b), [4f229a1](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/4f229a1e6ac4fe5246a7582585cd1bde78bd1e2b))

### ✨ New Features

* LINE: hide the Agent i and AI Friends buttons in LINE ([0ddc176](https://githubpatches/commit/0ddc1760a4f15edca734890968f0818b7cbb6215)), closes [#133](https://github.comhes/issues/133)
* LINE: hide the "CHECK" tips under LINE chat messages ([c2f234d](https://githubpatches/commit/c2f234da10ff8e7d856fa188d88047eb06a5244f))
* Facebook: add an AMOLED black theme for Facebook ([799d0ae](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/799d0aec55b4e409c6cec6b5f9d6b947240ab9ec)), closes [#108](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/issues/108)
* Facebook: add a download button beside every reel ([e0007d8](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/co1f38dfd6d21f45bbda8))
* Facebook: save stories and reels at the quality the player streams ([d250464](https://githubpatches/commit/d250464794c1882aac02d7617a06742efdbe75f4), [16a9184](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/16a9184e9284d1))

patches.name: [Ad] Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.

patches.name: [Ad] Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background, which saves data, battery and storage.

patches.name: [Ad] Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches.name: [Feed] Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches.name: [Feed] Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes posts that Facebook adds to the feed, such as "Pages you may like", upsells and surveys.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches.name: [General] AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: [General] Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches.name: [Reels] Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.

patches.name: [Reels] Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches.name: [Stories] Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.

patches.name: [Stories] Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches.name: [Ad] Hide ad views
patches.description: Hides LINE display ads: the LINE Ads banners, the Smart Channel banner in the chat list and Google AdManager ads.

patches.name: [Ad] Remove banner ads
patches.description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide AI Friends button
patches.description: Removes the AI Friends button from the Chats tab header. The Album button shows in its place.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide attach menu extra tools
patches.description: Removes the server-provided tools (Poll, Schedule and more) from the + menu in a chat. Built-in tiles stay.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide calendar buttons
patches.description: Removes every LINE Calendar button: in the Chats tab, the chat toolbar and menus, and the Home tab.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide community button
patches.description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide Events button
patches.description: Removes the "Events" row from the slide-out menu in a chat room. Events is a different feature from LINE Calendar, and it opens a server-hosted page.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide LINE GIFT button
patches.description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide tips under messages
patches.description: Hides the "CHECK" tips under some messages, such as a received video.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide Transfer button
patches.description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches.name: [Chat] Keep chats unread
patches.description: When you open a chat, LINE does not mark it read or send a read receipt. "Mark as read" still works.

patches.name: [Chat] Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Keeps messages that others unsend in 1:1 and group chats, with a notice below each one. OpenChat is not covered.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore chat backup sign-in via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Makes Google Drive chat backup and restore work on a re-signed build, through MicroG-RE. Root Mount does not need it.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore location maps via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Shows maps again on a re-signed build, with OpenFreeMap tiles. It needs MicroG-RE 7.0.0 or later. Root Mount does not need it.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore push notifications
patches.description: When LINE is fully closed, push notifications work again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches.name: [General] Disable VOOM
patches.description: VOOM deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing. If you open the standalone VOOM feed, it closes. Messaging and the other tabs do not change.

patches.name: [General] Hide Agent i buttons
patches.description: Removes the Agent i button from the Home header and from the search bar.

patches.name: [General] Hide new item badges
patches.description: Hides the green dots and N badges that mark new items, on header buttons, tabs, menus, lists and settings rows. Unread message counts do not change.

patches.name: [General] Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of LINE's in-app browser. LIFF mini-apps and LINE links stay in LINE.

patches.name: [General] Redirect LINE Pay
patches.description: Opens LINE Pay in the standalone LINE Pay app, so the integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs.

patches.name: [Home] Hide Home content feed
patches.description: Removes the content feed below the friends list on the Home tab: LINE NEWS, official account posts and rankings.

patches.name: [Home] Hide Home modules
patches.description: Hides the recommended content, hot-topics and ad modules on the Home tab.

patches.name: [Premium] Disable LINE Premium
patches.description: Hides all LINE Premium upsells, badges and pages. It unlocks nothing, because the server enforces Premium.

patches.name: [Premium] Hide premium unsend upsells
patches.description: Removes the Premium unsend upsells that "Disable LINE Premium" leaves. Ordinary unsend still works.

patches.name: [Tab] Hide LINE TODAY tab
patches.description: Removes the LINE TODAY (News) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the news-tab and news-row layouts.

patches.name: [Tab] Hide Shopping tab
patches.description: Removes the Shopping tab from the main bottom navigation. This includes the Japan variant (Shopping, ショッピング) and the Taiwan variant (Discover, 逛逛).

patches.name: [Tab] Hide VOOM tab
patches.description: Removes the VOOM (formerly Timeline) tab from the main bottom navigation.

patches.name: [Tab] Hide Wallet tab
patches.description: Removes the Wallet (LINE Pay) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the normal and mini-tab layouts.
